# Matias Sesto - Full Stack Developer

> Full stack developer and software student based in Buenos Aires, Argentina. I build web applications, smart contracts, and real-world systems.

## Projects

- [Animelink](https://www.animelink.lat): daily Connections-style puzzle for anime fans (React + Express + MongoDB).
- [Animedle](https://www.animedle.lat): anime guessing game with 6 modes, including real-time rooms (React + Express + MongoDB).
- [Deb8](https://deb8-6p72.onrender.com/): formal debate platform with text and voice support.
- [Coppay](https://github.com/coppaykipu/coppay-core): on-chain platform for CABA school cooperatives (I wrote the FirstRound contract).
- [Plant It](https://github.com/felig76/Plant-It): MERN + ESP32 plant-monitoring web app (Samsung Solve for Tomorrow semifinalist).
